description:
Our Core Team:

* Full-Stack Developer: Building our web platform and seamlessly integrating back-end logic with user interfaces.

* Data Analysts: Extracting, cleaning, and visualizing satellite observations and local agricultural datasets.

* Data Scientist & Pitch Lead: Developing predictive models for crop rotation and crafting a compelling narrative/pitch deck for the judges. 

Our Mission: To create a smart, data-driven decision-support tool that leverages NASA Earth observations
